idea-plugin.name: Action Runtime Sunset Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the GitHub Actions steps that stop running on 2026-09-23, with the version to move to

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Action Runtime Sunset Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 23 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/action-runtime-sunset-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/action-runtime-sunset-lint

action.text: Action Runtime Sunset Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Action Runtime Sunset Lint on the file in the editor
